QuestInfo.name: Queen's Tea 1
QuestInfo.0: Famous for being frivolous to a fault, the queen of #b#m260000000##k is also known for her picky taste... You better go see #b#p2101007##k.
QuestInfo.1: The queen #p2101007# is complaining that tea made with #t4000331#, considered the finest in this world, is not up to her taste. After some more complaining, she decides to drink a different tea, and asks you to get a #b#t4031577##k from #b#p2012012##k in #b#m200000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: When you asked #p2012012# for #t4031577#, #p2012012# gave you an awkward, disapproving look.

0.0: Ick, this is gross! Tea from barbarians. They may consider this drivel the finest around, but it does me no good. It's like drinking the very finest vinegar. A fairy with sensitive taste buds like me can't possibly drink tea made out of #t4000331#. You! Get #b#t4031577##k for me. NOW!

yes.0: You can't say no to a queen. Hahaha! #b#t4031577##k can be purchased from #b#p2012012##k of #b#m200000000##k. They might not want to sell it to you, but...that's your problem. I want to drink tea right this instant, so go to #m200000000# immediately.

no.0: What? Saying no to the queen? How idiotic... Don't think you'll last long in #m260000000# with that kind of attitude!

1.0: What is it? Huh? Do I know a fairy named #p2101007#?

npc.0: What is this, you still haven't gotten the #b#t4031577##k? Go see #b#p2012012##k right now. Seriously, this instant, or face my wrath...
